productionBaseline.currentRelaxationRule: two non-excluded validation answers; agreement is not currently required

candidateCompatibilitySignal.name: paired-validation-evidence-log-likelihood-ratio-v1
candidateCompatibilitySignal.definition: sum over the two fixed warm-path validation items of log P(observed evidence | warm prefix posterior) minus log P(observed evidence | cold prefix posterior)
candidateCompatibilitySignal.commonEvidenceContract: warm and cold probabilities use the identical question identity, observed evidence, preceding answer order, and validation metadata
candidateCompatibilitySignal.supportRule: relax to eight only when the cumulative log-likelihood ratio is at least zero
candidateCompatibilitySignal.counterfactualAction: when unsupported, keep the eligible warm prior but continue the exact diagnostic warm question path to at least 20 answers before applying ordinary stopping rules

precisionPlan.purpose: tail-sensitive development screen, not confirmatory non-inferiority
precisionPlan.independenceLimitation: bounds treat deterministic synthetic learner draws as independent and do not establish real-learner safety

decisionRule.failureAction: retain adverse evidence and reserve a new future development experiment before testing a different threshold or signal
